evidence_timing: outcome-blind historical replay of an already public target
question: Can completed customer-support runs predict task-level failure in a held-out model run?

development.evaluation: leave one model out within each domain

predictor: per-task failure frequency across the visible model runs
metrics: failure capture in the highest-risk 20 percent of tasks
claim_boundary: The study predicts failures in a held-out inference-time model run through an outcome-blind historical replay. It is not a temporally prospective test and does not evaluate RL training gains, causal task effects, or candidate-environment selection.
